TECHNOLOGIES 

Risk Management 

Risk Management 

Identifies, prioritizes, and mitigates software vulnerabilities, risky configurations, and user behavior. 

Ransomware Mitigation 

Ransomware Mitigation 

Detects suspicious encryption attempts, creates tamper-proof back-up copies of encrypted files, blocks encryption, and restores files.  

Process Protection 

Process Protection 

Continuous behavioral monitoring of all running processes that looks for signs of suspicious activity and automatically blocks processes when a certain threshold is reached.  

Tunable Machine Learning 

Tunable Machine Learning 

Machine learning algorithms that can be configured to be designed to identify and block targeted and advanced attacks at pre-execution. 



Threat Intelligence 

Threat Intelligence 

Insights from hundreds of millions of sensors and 260+ top researchers that enables GravityZone to anticipate, detect, and respond to attacks more effectively. 

Incident Advisor 

Incident Advisor 

A human-readable description of the incident’s root cause, MITRE tactics and techniques used, impact and recommended responses. 

Content Control 

Content Control 

Ability to restrict or schedule access to certain websites, web categories or URLs, and applications and configure data protection rules.  

  

Read More 

Exploit Defense 

Exploit Defense 

Protects against 0-day exploits by monitoring for specific exploitation techniques and behavior, and blocks processes that are suspicious. 



Network Attack Defense 

Network Attack Defense 

Checks incoming, outgoing and lateral traffic and protects against network-based attacks such as brute force attacks, port scans, password stealers, or lateral movement.



Sandbox Analyzer 

Sandbox Analyzer 

Automatic or manual analysis of potential threats in a safe cloud-hosted sandbox, delivering a verdict and a report of sample behavior. 

Anomaly Defense 

Anomaly Defense 

Machine learning based detection of unusual patterns or deviation from models of normal behavior that may require further investigation.  

Live Search 

Live Search 

Query systems in real-time to perform threat hunting by looking for specific Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) or to streamline administrative, inventory, or compliance tasks.
